;Armed conflicts and attacks
*2020 Chaman border clash
**Twenty-two people are killed in clashes between Afghan civilians and [[Pakistani military]] forces. Fifteen people died and 80 others injured in [[Kandahar]] after Pakistani soldiers attacked civilian areas, while seven people were killed and 31 others injured in Pakistan when a crowd trying to enter Afghanistan became unruly and attacked military installations. The [[Afghan government]] warns of action if Pakistan "continues its rocket attacks", while the Pakistani military says it opened fire in self-defense, returning fire to the Afghan side. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-afghanistan-clashes/afghanistan-and-pakistan-say-22-die-in-border-clashes-idUSKCN24W1AB?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***The [[Spanish economy]] suffers a historically large fall in the second quarter of 18.5% of [[GDP]] and enters in recession, making [[Spain]] the Eurozone country most economically devastated by the pandemic. [https://www.elmundo.es/economia/macroeconomia/2020/07/31/5f23c253fc6c8346718b4585.html (''El Mundo'')]
**[[Eurozone]] suffers an unprecedented 12.1% drop in GDP and enters in technical recession. [https://www.euronews.com/2020/07/31/coronavirus-euro-area-economy-shrinks-by-12-1-biggest-drop-on-record (Euronews)]
*[[James Murdoch]], the younger son of media mogul [[Rupert Murdoch]], resigns from the board of [[News Corp (2013–present)|News Corporation]] citing "disagreements over editorial content ... (and) some strategic decisions." News Corp owns media in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-53617966 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Isaias]] heads toward [[the Bahamas]] and the U.S. as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category 1]] hurricane, after causing floods and [[landslide]]s in the [[Dominican Republic]] and [[Puerto Rico]]. A hurricane warning is issued for [[Florida]]'s [[East Coast of the United States|Atlantic Coast]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/bahamas-braces-as-newly-formed-hurricane-isaias-bears-down/a-54387823 (DW)] [https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2020-07-31-hurricane-warning-florida-isaias-bahamas-forecast (The Weather Channel)]
*[[2020 Kenai Peninsula mid-air collision]]
**Seven people are killed in a [[mid-air collision]] near [[Soldotna, Alaska]], United States. Among those killed was Alaska State Representative [[Gary Knopp]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/07/31/us/alaska-plane-crash-gary-knopp.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.ktuu.com/2020/07/31/sterling-highway-open-following-a-plane-crash-in-soldotna/ (KTUU-TV)]
*A minibus accident in [[Crimea]] (a disputed territory of [[Ukraine]] and [[Russia]]) leaves at least nine people dead and another nine wounded. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-crimea-accident/nine-killed-in-crimea-minibus-crash-after-driver-falls-asleep-at-wheel-idUSKCN24W116 (Reuters)]
*An [[Alfa Pendular]] high-speed train derails in [[Coimbra]], [[Portugal]], killing two people and injuring at least 30 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53615259 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 82 new COVID-19 cases in a day. [https://ncov.moh.gov.vn/dong-thoi-gian (Vietnamese Heath Ministry)]
****Vietnam reports its first two deaths from COVID-19. The two men, "Patient 428" and "Patient 437" died of "complications from background diseases and COVID-19". [https://vnexpress.net/them-mot-benh-nhan-covid-19-tu-vong-4139522.html (VnExpress)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] downgrades the lockdown restrictions on [[Cebu City]] to the level of "[[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines#General community quarantine (GCQ)|general community quarantine]]", while extending the same level of restriction on [[Metro Manila]] until mid-August. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/philippines-extends-coronavirus-lockdown-200731031132604.html (Al Jazeera)]
****The Philippines report a record high of 4,063 new cases of COVID-19 since the pandemic began. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-philippines-cases/philippines-records-4063-new-coronavirus-cases-se-asias-highest-jump-for-2nd-day-idUSL2N2F200O (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] registers another record of new COVID-19 cases in a single day since the pandemic began, with 463 new cases. Governor [[Yuriko Koike]] says the city may need to declare its own state of emergency if the virus continues to spread. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/07/31/national/tokyo-second-emergency-coronavirus/ (''The Japan Times'')]
****Japan reports another record of more than 1,500 cases in a single day. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/07/660e2a970849-breaking-news-tokyo-to-report-over-400-new-coronavirus-cases-record-daily-rise.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a record 55,079 new COVID-19 cases, as well as 779 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 37,223 COVID-19 patients were cured and discharged, which also is the highest number of recoveries since the pandemic began. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/record-55-000-new-coronavirus-cases-in-india-in-a-day-37-000-recover-11596165032570.html (''Livemint'')]
****India surpasses [[Italy]] in COVID-19 deaths, becoming the fifth-highest. [https://www.india.com/news/india/coronavirus-india-surpasses-italy-to-claim-5th-position-on-global-covid-19-deaths-chart-4098891/ (India.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] reports 127 new cases of COVID-19 in the last 24 hours. From that, 123 of them were locally transmitted which includes 112 in [[Xinjiang]] and 11 in [[Liaoning]]. It is the highest number of cases reported since March 5. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china/china-reports-127-new-coronavirus-cases-highest-since-march-5-idUSKCN24W01L (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****The number of COVID-19 deaths in [[Mexico]] reaches 46,688, surpassing the [[United Kingdom]]. The death toll in the country is the third-highest in the world. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/mexico-surpasses-britain-with-third-highest-covid-19-death-toll-12982106 (CNA)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-latam/mexico-eclipses-britain-with-third-highest-coronavirus-death-toll-idUKKCN24W2SC (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The [[Federal government of the United States|United States government]] is expected to pay $2.1 billion to [[Sanofi]] and [[GlaxoSmithKline]] to try to develop and deliver 100 million doses of their potential [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/07/31/us-agrees-to-pay-sanofi-and-gsk-2point1-billion-for-100-million-doses-of-coronavirus-vaccine.html (CNBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] postpones lockdown easing in England, for at least two weeks, after an increase in coronavirus cases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-53609467 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
***Fiji reports its first death from COVID-19. Health minister [[Ifereimi Waqainabete]] reported it as a 66-year-old man who had been repatriated from [[India]] where he had been receiving treatment. The man apparently contracted it while in India. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/422471/fiji-records-first-covid-19-death (RNZ)]
**The [[World Health Organization]] reports a record increase in global COVID-19 cases in the last 24 hours, with the total rising by more than 292,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-who-cases/who-reports-record-daily-increase-in-global-coronavirus-cases-up-over-292000-idUSKCN24W2NN (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Bahamas]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[The Bahamas]] announces that travelers from the [[United States]] will be required to either present a negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]] or quarantine for 14 days. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/travel/news/2020/07/31/bahamas-reopens-american-travelers-strict-covid-19-protocol/5557647002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Twitter bitcoin scam]]
**A 17-year-old boy in [[Tampa]], [[Florida]], U.S., is arrested and charged for his role in the Twitter [[bitcoin]] hack earlier this month. Two others, a man in [[Orlando, Florida]] and a man in the [[United Kingdom]], were also charged. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/teenager-arrested-twitter-bitcoin-hack-183302700.html (Yahoo! Finance)]
*Nine people are killed and five others injured during a shooting amid a dispute over ownership of a forest in [[Upper Dir]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1572056/nine-killed-in-upper-dir-over-forest-ownership-dispute (''Dawn'')]
*The [[United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit|U.S. Court of Appeals for the First Circuit]] overturns the death sentence of [[Boston Marathon bombing|Boston Marathon bomber]] [[Dzhokhar Tsarnaev]] on five counts, ruling the judge erred several times in their initial decision. A new sentencing trial will take place. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/31/us/boston-marathon-bomber-dzhokhar-tsarnaev-sentence-vacated/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**The [[government of Afghanistan|government]] and the [[Taliban]] begin a three-day truce to start intra-Afghan talks. Early today, [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] ordered the release of 500 Taliban prisoners to "show goodwill" to start the talks. [https://www.dw.com/en/afghan-ceasefire-begins-taliban-prisoners-freed-ahead-of-possible-talks/a-54389002 (DW)]
*[[Postponement of the 2020 Hong Kong legislative election]]
**Citing the threat of [[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong|COVID-19]], [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Chief Executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] invokes emergency powers to postpone [[Hong Kong]]'s election until [[2021 Hong Kong legislative election|September 5, 2021]]. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/national-international/hong-kong-government-postpones-elections-citing-coronavirus/2544166/ (WNBC-TV)]
*The [[House of Lords|UK House of Lords]] adds 36 new peers to their ranks. New members include Boris Johnson's brother [[Jo Johnson]], former [[cricket]] captain [[Ian Botham|Sir Ian Botham]], ''[[Evening Standard]]'' owner [[Evgeny Lebedev]], and former [[Chancellor of the Exchequer|chancellors]] [[Kenneth Clarke]] and [[Philip Hammond]]. [[Lord Speaker]] [[Norman Fowler, Baron Fowler|Norman Fowler]] criticizes these peerages for making the House too large. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-53606083 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[White supremacist]] [[David Duke]] is permanently suspended from [[Twitter]] for repeatedly violating its rules on [[hate speech]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2020/07/31/twitter-david-duke-ban/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces his intentions to ban [[TikTok]] from operating in the U.S.. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/510100-trump-says-he-will-ban-tiktok-from-operating-in-the-us (''The Hill'')]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[Major League Baseball]] (MLB) reschedules today's series opener between the [[Milwaukee Brewers]] and host [[St. Louis Cardinals]] to be part of a Sunday [[Doubleheader (baseball)|doubleheader]] because two St. Louis players received positive  results from COVID-19 tests administered following  the conclusion of the Cards-[[Minneapolis Twins]] series.  The Twins played  the [[Cleveland Indians]] last night. This is the 15th MLB game postponed by positive COVID-19 results  just eight days into the 2020 season. [https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/cardinals-brewers-game-postponed-after-two-st-louis-players-test-positive-for-covid-19/ (CBS Sports)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-baseball-mlb-stl/mlb-reschedules-cardinals-game-after-positive-tests-idUSKCN24W29S (Reuters)]
